name: ARCAS Short (NASA TN D-4013/D-4014 half-scale tunnel model, Config 1)
_notes: Geometry from NASA TN D-4013/D-4014 (half-scale tunnel model). d = 2.250 in = 0.05715 m. Total 18.20 d = 40.95 in (nose 10.6 + body 28.54 + boattail 1.81).

RE-FIXTURED 2026-08-25 from Chuck Rogers' own ARCAS-Long CDX1 (run through the app's real importCdx1) reconciled against the TN D-4013/D-4014 drawings reproduced in 'RASAero II Comparisons with ARCAS CP and CD Data' (slides 3-5). He is the RASAero co-author and this is the configuration he compared against the tunnel; the anchor dots were read through that comparison. Three conflicts resolved against the reports:

1. BOATTAIL REAR DIA 1.308 in (was 1.47): D-4014 Detail A dimensions the cone base R 0.654 (dia 1.308) with a 0.053-in reflexed lip flaring to 1.470 D. 1.470 is NOT a misreading — it is the drawings' own dimensioned base diameter (D-4013 Fig 1(b) '.65d' = 1.4625; Detail A '1.470 D'), and the old fixture used it deliberately. The defect was using it as the transition AFT RADIUS, which forces a 12.3 deg cone (atan(0.39/1.81)) against the drawn 15 deg. The cone base follows from the drawing: 2.250 - 2*(1.810-0.053)*tan(15 deg) = 1.30843 = 2 x 0.65421, matching Detail A's R to three decimals. Length stays 1.810 in so the overall station math (53.500 / 40.950) is exact; the implied 14.58 deg local slope is endpoint-exact and second-order. RASAero excluded the lip as buried in the boattail boundary layer (comparison doc slide 2); this fixture follows.

2. FIN THICKNESS 0.123 in (was 0.150): D-4014 Fig 1(b) fin section tapers SPANWISE 0.150 (root) -> 0.096 (tip), total taper angle 1.47 deg ( = 2*atan(0.027/2.103) ). 0.123 is the exact mean - the same single-thickness convention Rogers used in the CDX1. 0.150 was the root (max) value and overstated the t^2 wave term by ~49%.

3. TIP CHORD 2.165 in (was 2.09): D-4014 Fig 1(b) dimensions the tip chord 2.165 (5.499 cm) directly; the old 2.09 was D-4013 Fig 1(b)'s rounded '.93d' read. Sweep 1.215 in = 2.103 * tan(30 deg LE sweep).

FIN SECTION: double wedge, LE chamfer FX1 = 1.4863 in = 0.0377521 m, TE chamfer DERIVED = mean chord - FX1 = 1.2862 in = 0.0326695 m (the file's FX3 is a stale UI field - see importCdx1). LE wedge 2.72 deg (typ) normal to the 15-deg line, sharp LE (LERadius 0). Replaces the 'airfoil' placeholder, which produced no section-specific wave or base terms and (flag on) cancelled the removed blunt-LE plateau against the +80% junction term.

FIN STATION: root LE 1.84 in ahead of the boattail start (D-4014 stations 37.30/49.85), root TE overhanging the boattail by 1.54 in -> position bottom +0.0391161 m, exactly what importCdx1 produces. The kernel keeps the full tube radius under the overhang; RASAero projects onto an equal-volume cylinder (comparison doc slide 10). MEASURED 2026-08-25: the old flush placement sat the fins 1.54 in forward of truth and moved model CP ~2.7 %L forward - a compensating error that had been holding the supersonic CP gates green.

NOT MODELED, measured/bounded: the 4 fin-root anchors (protuberance, 0.178 in^2 total frontal; RASAero entered them as an equivalent rail guide). A protuberance component now EXISTS in the app (2026-08-25) and on this geometry contributes +0.0132599 CD, Mach-flat (frontal 1.1483848e-4 m^2 / aRef 2.5652066e-3 m^2 = area ratio 0.0447677, x this body's own CD 0.2961944 - the 'streamlined with base drag' class stopped being the flat Cd 0.22 in v0.069 and is now the design's own body CD including base at M0.3, measured by treeModel.bodyDragReference with the fin set stripped, i.e. on exactly the arcas-short-finsoff geometry); it was +0.0098489 under the retired 0.22. Rogers' own div-5 rail-guide equivalence implies Cd 0.234, which the body-referenced class now sits ABOVE rather than below. It is deliberately NOT in this fixture, which stays a clean-airframe cell matching what the tunnel model measured minus the anchors, so kernel CD reads LOW by that much. (An earlier note here claimed a '2-railbutton proxy measured +0.002-0.005 CD'; that does not reproduce - two DEFAULT 9.7 mm kernel rail buttons on this geometry measure +0.008980 at M0.3 rising to +0.022406 at M1.8.); the nose tip blunt radius 0.062 in; the base lip 1.308 -> 1.470 D over 0.053 in (excluded per RASAero, but the physical model's aft-facing area IS the 1.470 D disc, so kernel base CD reads LOW by ~0.012 at M1.8 decaying to ~0.005 at M4.65 - measured base component 0.0469 at 1.308 D vs 0.0593 at 1.470 D). All three omissions run the same way (kernel LOW), opposite the model's transonic overshoot, so none of them rescues a red gate - they make the model error slightly larger, not smaller.

Finish: finishpolished (0.5 um) = importCdx1's mapping of RASAero 'Smooth (Zero Roughness)'. Measured vs the old 'polished' (2 um): CD delta 0.0000 at every gate Mach under machAlt Re-matching (not roughness-limited).
Thicknesses are nominal: mass does not affect CP/CD scoring.
